purpose: Teach: 吸収/原料/発掘/天候/未知/絶滅/換算/沿岸

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、薬物の、絶対、吸収、絶対、過程、絶対、分析しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The police are conducting a thorough analysis of the drug manufacturing and distribution process with complete seriousness.
lines.style: Measured, official tone. Clipped syllables on key procedural words. Maintains professional distance. Steady breath. No apology in the delivery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、密造の、絶対、原料、絶対、警察、絶対、押収、絶対、されたんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So the raw materials from the illegal manufacturing operation were seized by police in this case, is that right?
lines.style: Careful, probing curiosity. Slight upward inflection at the end like checking his understanding. Thoughtful pause before speaking. Respectful but genuinely interested.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。証拠の、本気で、絶対、発掘、絶対、警察、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're being thorough in uncovering and preserving all evidence related to the case.
lines.style: Crisp, official confirmation. Small nod in the voice on the affirmative. Each clause distinct and weighed. Confident without being stiff.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、天候、絶対、影響で、絶対、警察、絶対、捜査延期、絶対、されたそうですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I understand the investigation was postponed due to weather conditions — is that correct?
lines.style: Thoughtful, connecting pieces quietly. Gentle interrogative at the end, not demanding. Shows he's been listening. Measured pace, like he's considering the implications.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。容疑者の、本気で、絶対、未知、絶対、の経歴、絶対、警察、絶対、調査しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're currently investigating the suspect's background, which has proven to be less known than we initially expected.
lines.style: Straightforward procedural update. Slight weight on 'currently investigating' — ongoing work. No defensiveness about the limited information. Professional candor.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、地域の、絶対、伝統文化、絶対、絶滅、絶対、危機、絶対、警察、絶対、保護されたんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So there's a concern about the extinction of local cultural traditions — and the police have been working to protect that heritage?
lines.style: Quieter now, more genuinely wondering. Slower pace. Shows he understands the stakes beyond the criminal case. Respectful of what's at risk.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。被害額の、本気で、絶対、換算、絶対、警察、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're currently calculating the full extent of the damages to proceed with the next steps.
lines.style: Clinical but not cold. Matter-of-fact on the damage assessment. Slight pause before 'proceed' — acknowledging the weight of that word.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、沿岸、絶対、警備、絶対、警察、絶対、強化、絶対、されたそうですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: And coastal security has been strengthened as a result of this investigation, I believe?
lines.style: Final check-in, reflective and closing. Slight lift at the end like he's drawing threads together. Slower than before. Respectful finality.
